title: Cloud Build Build Failures and Duration

description: Build failures block deployments. Duration trends support pipeline optimization and quota management.
value: Detecting cloud build build failures and duration early reduces mean time to contain cloud incidents, supports audit logging controls, and prevents silent misconfiguration drift across accounts.
implementation: Sink Cloud Build logs to Pub/Sub; ingest in Splunk. Alert when status=FAILURE or TIMEOUT. Track build duration and success rate by trigger. Correlate with source repo and branch.

detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=gcp`.
• Install and configure `Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform` with the modular input for `google:gcp:pubsub:message`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.3.41.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `messageId` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Sink Cloud Build logs to Pub/Sub; ingest in Splunk. Alert when status=FAILURE or TIMEOUT. Track build duration and success rate by trigger. Correlate with source repo and branch.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:pubsub:message" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:pubsub:message" resource.type="build" status="FAILURE"
| table _time messageId publishTime attributes
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.3.13_cloud_build_build_failur_13"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `google:gcp:pubsub:message` in `index=gcp` to detect cloud build build failures and duration. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the provider cloud console audit view for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `messageId` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_3_13_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Line chart (builds, failures by trigger), Table (build, trigger, status, duration), Single value (failure rate)..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade `Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform` and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of cloud build build failures and duration so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
